# Calling Matrix

> 24/7 AI receptionist purpose-built for home service businesses. Answers every call in under 2 seconds, routes emergencies, books jobs directly into field-service software.

## What Calling Matrix does

Calling Matrix is an AI phone receptionist for trade businesses — HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, cleaning, landscaping, pest control, garage door, appliance repair, and locksmith companies. It answers inbound calls 24/7, qualifies leads, routes emergencies to on-call technicians, and books jobs directly into scheduling software with no manual entry.

## Who it's for

Home service businesses that lose revenue to missed calls: technicians who can't answer while on a job, owners who don't have front-desk staff, businesses that need after-hours coverage without hiring, and companies that handle surge volume (storm season for HVAC and roofing, spring for landscaping).

## Pricing

- Starter: $497/month — unlimited inbound calls, core integrations, 24/7 answering
- Growth: $797/month — unlimited calls, advanced routing, multi-location support
- Scale: Custom pricing for enterprise and multi-location operations

Flat monthly rate. No per-minute charges. No overage fees. Call volume does not affect the price.

## Integrations

Native integrations with:
- Housecall Pro (field service management)
- ServiceTitan (enterprise field service)
- Jobber (small/mid business field service)
- FieldEdge (HVAC/plumbing dispatch)
- Google Calendar (scheduling)
- Calendly (appointment booking)
- Zapier (connects to 5,000+ apps)

## How it works

1. Inbound call answered in under 2 seconds
2. AI qualifies the caller — service address, job type, urgency
3. Emergency calls route immediately to on-call tech via SMS
4. Non-urgent jobs booked directly into scheduling software
5. Customer receives SMS confirmation

## Setup

Live in 48 hours. Includes a 30-minute onboarding call to capture services, pricing, service area, and emergency routing protocols. Phone number porting handled by Calling Matrix — customers see no change.

## Key differentiators

- Flat-rate pricing vs per-minute live answering services
- Industry-specific training vs general AI phone agents
- Direct CRM booking vs message relay that requires manual entry
- Unlimited surge capacity vs agent-pool limits
- 48-hour setup vs 1–2 week live answering onboarding
